title: Compile role-complete operation presentation plans

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:operation-presentation-plans; npm run typecheck
verificationRecords.notes: Four inventory laws pass and application, Node, test, and domain typechecks pass.

progress.summary: Approved run contract v2 is active. Slice 1 froze the current migration surface as executable inventory: five optional reader-plan seams, seven compositor inputs, five flat cancellation authoring sites, and three metadata-versus-behavior evidence gaps.

expectedLearning: Whether one role-complete presentation-plan boundary eliminates correct-label/wrong-realization regressions without a second renderer or closed extension taxonomy.
allowedWork: Define and migrate the approved role vocabulary, plan union, validator, laws, registry resolution, named canonical bindings, generated cancellation path, and stable verification.
disallowedWork: No new math semantics, layout-engine redesign, compositor/runtime/lifecycle/scheduler, LLM presentation authority, or pre-checkpoint cross-family generalization.
